changelog: **The transactional outbox is the event bus (#1680):** `DomainEvent` gains `status` (PENDING/RELAYED/FAILED), `relayedAt` and `attempts` (additive). `src/lib/events/publish.ts` writes an event in the caller's own transaction — `publishEvent(tx, …)` (the type refuses the root client), `publishEventOp(…)` for array transactions, `withEvents(fn)` for callers without one — validating against the catalogue and throwing inside the transaction on a drifted payload. `src/lib/events/relay.ts` turns committed rows into one `events.deliver` job per subscriber (keyed `${eventId}:${subscriber}`, so a retried relay never delivers twice), one row per transaction, per-subject `createdAt` order, no lease (SKIP LOCKED on every replica, ticked every 30 s by `POST /api/events/relay` and kicked after each publish), bound to the no-tenant context so `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` cannot filter it to one org; `EVENTS_RELAY_ENABLED=0` switches it off (the deploy canary). `pipeline.stage_change` is now written atomically with the move by the mentorship PUT, the bulk advance and `/api/status-changes`; the other stage paths write it right after their commit (burndown in `docs/domain-events.md`). The retention entry never prunes a PENDING event.
